title: Parameter
description: A measured or derived echocardiographic parameter (TS-02.2.1). One file per parameter: content/parameters/<id>.yaml. Values reference parameters by id.

name.description: Full name, e.g. 'Effective regurgitant orifice area'.

abbreviation.description: Abbreviation shown in tables and indexed by search, e.g. 'EROA'.

unit.description: Common unit of the parameter, used to compare values across sources (decision PO-4). Values keep and display their published unit, which may be another unit of the same quantity.

modalities.description: Modalities in which the parameter is measured; each value names one of them.

synonyms.description: Alternative names and abbreviations indexed by search (ADR 0004).

method.description: View / method note: how and where it is measured, pitfalls (METH).
